title: Contractor Reassignment Uplift for Extra Trips, Optional Coverage Add-Ons
content:
A reassignment uplift is added to the haul-away limit for equipment replaced under an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider, for the extra trips on the request, counted from the contractor assignments the request shows:

| Contractor assignments on the request | Reassignment uplift |
|---|---|
| Three or more | USD 30.00 |
| Exactly two | USD 15.00 |
| One or none | None |

Every assignment recorded on that rider service request counts, the first assignment included.

**Hypothetical cases.** A request first assigned and then re-dispatched once shows two assignments: USD 15.00 is added. A request re-dispatched twice shows three: USD 30.00.
